BOOK2_LESSON_SEVEN_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–6 · Traveling to Hualien by Train

dialogue.title: 坐火車到花蓮去旅行
grammarFocus: 一 + M（+N）+ 都／也 + Neg（+Vaux）+ V
一點兒 + 都／也 + Neg + Vs

text.traditional: （在教室）
text.simplified: （在教室）
text.pinyin: (Zài jiàoshì)
text.english: (In a classroom)

text.traditional: 還有一個星期就要放假了，我打算到花蓮去旅行，好好看看台灣東部的風景。
text.simplified: 还有一个星期就要放假了，我打算到花莲去旅行，好好看看台湾东部的风景。
text.pinyin: Háiyǒu yíge xīngqí jiùyào fàngjià le, wǒ dǎsuàn dào Huālián qù lǚxíng, hǎohǎo kànkan Táiwān dōngbù de fēngjǐng.
text.english: It's only one week until the holidays. I'm planning to go to Hualien and take a thorough look at the scenery of eastern Taiwan.

text.traditional: 前年我去花蓮玩，住在朋友的民宿，他不但請我吃飯，還送給我好幾包當地的名產跟風景明信片呢！
text.simplified: 前年我去花莲玩，住在朋友的民宿，他不但请我吃饭，还送给我好几包当地的名产跟风景明信片呢！
text.pinyin: Qiánnián wǒ qù Huālián wán, zhù zài péngyǒu de mínsù, tā búdàn qǐng wǒ chīfàn, hái sòng gěi wǒ hǎojǐ bāo dāngdì de míngchǎn gēn fēngjǐng míngxìnpiàn ne!
text.english: I went on a trip to Hualien two years ago and stayed at a friend's bed and breakfast. He not only treated me to a meal, but also gave me quite a few bags of local specialty and postcards with landscapes!

text.traditional: 真好！你可以幫我訂那家民宿嗎？
text.simplified: 真好！你可以帮我订那家民宿吗？
text.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo! Nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ dìng nà jiā mínsù ma?
text.english: That's really nice! Can you help me book that bed and breakfast?

text.traditional: 可以啊！他的民宿有游泳池，也有免費的無線網路，最棒的是，從房間往外看，還可以看到美麗的大海，你一定會喜歡的。
text.simplified: 可以啊！他的民宿有游泳池，也有免费的无线网路，最棒的是，从房间往外看，还可以看到美丽的大海，你一定会喜欢的。
text.pinyin: Kěyǐ a! Tā de mínsù yǒu yóuyǒngchí, yě yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, zuì bàng de shì, cóng fángjiān wǎng wài kàn, hái kěyǐ kàndào měilì de dàhǎi, nǐ yídìng huì xǐhuān de.
text.english: Yes, I can! His bed and breakfast has a swimming pool and free Wi-Fi. The best thing is that you can see the beautiful ocean when you look outside from your room, and you will definitely like it.

text.traditional: 住一個晚上要多少錢？要是太貴，我就住不起了。
text.simplified: 住一个晚上要多少钱？要是太贵，我就住不起了。
text.pinyin: Zhù yíge wǎnshàng yào duōshǎo qián? Yàoshì tài guì, wǒ jiù zhù bù qǐ le.
text.english: How much is it for a night? If it's too expensive, I may not afford it.

text.traditional: 別擔心，我會跟他說你是學生，請他算便宜一點兒。
text.simplified: 别担心，我会跟他说你是学生，请他算便宜一点儿。
text.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, wǒ huì gēn tā shuō nǐ shì xuéshēng, qǐng tā suàn piányí yìdiǎnr.
text.english: Don't worry! I'll tell him you are a student and ask him to make it a bit cheaper for you.

text.traditional: （良介拿出一塊錢來）
text.simplified: （良介拿出一块钱来）
text.pinyin: (Liángjiè ná chū yíkuài qián lái)
text.english: (Ryosuke takes out a dollar.)

text.traditional: （笑著說）你看！我只剩下一塊錢，沒錢吃飯了。
text.simplified: （笑着说）你看！我只剩下一块钱，没钱吃饭了。
text.pinyin: (Xiào zhe shuō) Nǐ kàn! Wǒ zhǐ shèngxià yíkuài qián, méi qián chīfàn le.
text.english: (laughing) Look! I only have a dollar left. I have no money for food.

text.traditional: 你比我好，我今天出門時忘了帶錢包，現在一毛錢都沒有，我們中午讓美心請客吧。
text.simplified: 你比我好，我今天出门时忘了带钱包，现在一毛钱都没有，我们中午让美心请客吧。
text.pinyin: Nǐ bǐ wǒ hǎo, wǒ jīntiān chūmén shí wàngle dài qiánbāo, xiànzài yì máo qián dōu méiyǒu, wǒmen zhōngwǔ ràng Měixīn qǐngkè ba.
text.english: You're better than me. I forgot my wallet when I went out today. Now I don't even have a single cent. We shall let Meixin buy us lunch.

text.traditional: （兩人哈哈大笑。這時候，美心剛好從外面走進來）
text.simplified: （两人哈哈大笑。这时候，美心刚好从外面走进来）
text.pinyin: (Liǎng rén hāhā dàxiào. Zhè shí hòu, Měixīn gānghǎo cóng wàimiàn zǒu jìn lái)
text.english: (Both of them are laughing out loud. At that very moment, Meixin walks in.)

text.traditional: 你們在聊什麼？聊得這麼開心？
text.simplified: 你们在聊什么？聊得这么开心？
text.pinyin: Nǐmen zài liáo shénme? Liáo de zhème kāixīn?
text.english: What are you chatting about? You are chatting so happily, aren't you?

text.traditional: 我們正在聊去花蓮旅行的事，可欣要幫我訂民宿。
text.simplified: 我们正在聊去花莲旅行的事，可欣要帮我订民宿。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài liáo qù Huālián lǚxíng de shì, Kěxīn yào bāng wǒ dìng mínsù.
text.english: We are talking about traveling to Hualien. Kexin is going to help me book a bed and breakfast.

text.traditional: 住民宿不錯，你要怎麼去呢？
text.simplified: 住民宿不错，你要怎么去呢？
text.pinyin: Zhù mínsù búcuò, nǐ yào zěnme qù ne?
text.english: Staying at a bed and breakfast is good. How are you planning to go?

text.traditional: 我還沒決定。聽說蘇花公路有一點兒危險，下大雨的時候，山上的大石頭可能會掉下來。
text.simplified: 我还没决定。听说苏花公路有一点儿危险，下大雨的时候，山上的大石头可能会掉下来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ háiméi juédìng. Tīngshuō Sūhuā Gōnglù yǒuyìdiǎnr wéixiǎn, xià dàyǔ de shíhòu, shān shàng de dà shítou kěnéng huì diàoxiàlái.
text.english: I haven't decided yet. I heard that Suhua Highway is a little bit dangerous. During heavy rains, the mountain rocks may fall down.

text.traditional: 蘇花公路是比較危險，搭火車去比較安全，可是假日的票很難買，一下子就賣光了，你最好趕快上網訂票。
text.simplified: 苏花公路是比较危险，搭火车去比较安全，可是假日的票很难买，一下子就卖光了，你最好赶快上网订票。
text.pinyin: Sūhuā Gōnglù shì bǐjiào wéixiǎn, dā huǒchē qù bǐjiào ānquán, kěshì jiàrì de piào hěn nán mǎi, yíxiàzi jiù mài guāng le, nǐ zuìhǎo gǎnkuài shàngwǎng dìngpiào.
text.english: Suhua Highway is indeed more dangerous. Taking the train is safer, but the tickets for holidays are difficult to buy. It only takes a short while until they are sold out. You'd better hurry up and book them online.

text.traditional: 我上過台灣鐵路局的網站，可是看不懂網頁，覺得訂票很難。
text.simplified: 我上过台湾铁路局的网站，可是看不懂网页，觉得订票很难。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shàng guò Táiwān Tiělùjú de wǎngzhàn, kěshì kàn bù dǒng wǎngyè, juéde dìngpiào hěn nán.
text.english: I visited the website of Taiwan Railways, but I didn't understand the web pages. I think booking tickets is very difficult.

text.traditional: 在台灣，上網訂票、訂位一點兒都不難，我現在就幫你訂。（用手機上台鐵的網站）你要訂什麼時候的？
text.simplified: 在台湾，上网订票、订位一点儿都不难，我现在就帮你订。（用手机上台铁的网站）你要订什么时候的？
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shàngwǎng dìngpiào, dìngwèi yìdiǎnr dōu bù nán, wǒ xiànzài jiù bāng nǐ dìng. (Yòng shǒujī shàng Táitiě de wǎngzhàn) Nǐ yào dìng shénme shíhòu de?
text.english: In Taiwan, booking tickets or making a reservation online is not difficult at all. I can help you book them now. (She entered the website of Taiwan Railways on her cellphone.) For when do you want to book the tickets?

text.traditional: 大概六月底。火車票貴不貴？
text.simplified: 大概六月底。火车票贵不贵？
text.pinyin: Dàgài liù yuè dǐ. Huǒchē piào guì bú guì?
text.english: Approximately for the end of June. Are the train tickets expensive?

text.traditional: 太魯閣號比較貴，可是只停幾個站，兩個多鐘頭就到花蓮了。
text.simplified: 太鲁阁号比较贵，可是只停几个站，两个多钟头就到花莲了。
text.pinyin: Tàilǔgé Hào bǐjiào guì, kěshì zhǐ tíng jǐ ge zhàn, liǎng ge duō zhōngtóu jiù dào Huālián le.
text.english: The Taroko Express is more expensive, but stops only at a few stations. It only takes a bit over two hours to arrive in Hualien.

text.traditional: 貴一點兒沒關係，要是訂得到第一班太魯閣號，早上從台北出發，中午就可以去太魯閣國家公園爬山了。
text.simplified: 贵一点儿没关系，要是订得到第一班太鲁阁号，早上从台北出发，中午就可以去太鲁阁国家公园爬山了。
text.pinyin: Guì yìdiǎnr méiguānxi, yàoshì dìng de dào dìyī bān Tàilǔgé Hào, zǎoshàng cóng Táiběi chūfā, zhōngwǔ jiù kěyǐ qù Tàilǔgé guójiā gōngyuán páshān le.
text.english: It's alright if it's a bit expensive. If I can book the first Taroko Express trip and leave from Taipei in the morning, I will be able to go to Taroko National Park to climb the mountains at noon.

text.traditional: 我前年就是搭太魯閣號去的，真的又快又方便！
text.simplified: 我前年就是搭太鲁阁号去的，真的又快又方便！
text.pinyin: Wǒ qiánnián jiùshì dā Tàilǔgé Hào qù de, zhēnde yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn!
text.english: Two years ago I went by the Taroko Express, too. It is really fast and convenient!

text.traditional: 不好意思，我想坐在窗戶旁邊，可以自己選座位嗎？
text.simplified: 不好意思，我想坐在窗户旁边，可以自己选座位吗？
text.pinyin: Bùhǎoyìsi, wǒ xiǎng zuò zài chuānghù pángbiān, kěyǐ zìjǐ xuǎn zuòwèi ma?
text.english: Excuse me. I want to sit by the window. Can I choose the seat by myself?

text.traditional: 沒辦法，位子都是電腦選的。（看著網頁）訂好了！你把訂票號碼記下來，這個日期以前去便利商店付錢，就可以拿到票了。
text.simplified: 没办法，位子都是电脑选的。（看着网页）订好了！你把订票号码记下来，这个日期以前去便利商店付钱，就可以拿到票了。
text.pinyin: Méibànfǎ, wèizi dōu shì diànnǎo xuǎn de. (Kàn zhe wǎngyè) Dìng hǎo le! Nǐ bǎ dìngpiào hàomǎ jìxiàlái, zhège rìqí yǐqián qù biànlì shāngdiàn fù qián, jiù kěyǐ ná dào piào le.
text.english: There's no way. The seats are all chosen by the computer. (She looks at the website.) Already booked! Write the reservation number down, and go to a convenience store to pay before this date. After that, you can get your tickets.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: 不但…，還…: not only… but also…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a second, more important point with 不但…，還….
grammarPages.explanation: In addition to the situation after “不但”, the speaker lays more stress on the situation after “還”. In this pattern, the first subject should be consistent with the second one.

text.traditional: 我去夜市，不但要吃雞排，還要吃蚵仔煎。
text.simplified: 我去夜市，不但要吃鸡排，还要吃蚵仔煎。
text.pinyin: Wǒ qù yèshì, búdàn yào chī jīpái, háiyào chī ézǐjiān.
text.english: When I go to the night market, I want to eat not only chicken cutlet but also oyster omelet.

text.traditional: 那個印尼學生不但會說中文，還會寫很多中國字。
text.simplified: 那个印尼学生不但会说中文，还会写很多中国字。
text.pinyin: Nà ge Yìnní xuéshēng búdàn huì shuō Zhōngwén, hái huì xiě hěn duō Zhōngguó zì.
text.english: That Indonesian student can not only speak Chinese but also write many Chinese characters.

text.traditional: 這家民宿不但有免費的無線網路，還有游泳池呢！
text.simplified: 这家民宿不但有免费的无线网路，还有游泳池呢！
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù búdàn yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, háiyǒu yóuyǒngchí ne!
text.english: This B&B not only has free Wi-Fi but also a swimming pool!

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In addition to the situation after “不但”, the speaker lays more stress on the situation after “還”. In this pattern, the first subject should be consistent with the second one.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In addition to the situation after “不但”, the speaker lays more stress on the situation after “還”. In this pattern, the first subject should be consistent with the second one.

grammarPages.titleTraditional: 一 + M（+N）+ 都／也 + Neg（+Vaux）+ V
grammarPages.titleSimplified: 一 + M（+N）+ 都／也 + Neg（+Vaux）+ V
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 一 + Measure word + 都/也 + not: not even one
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize that there is not even one of something.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “一 M 都/也不（沒）” indicates “there is not any...” or “don't want any...”, and shows a strange and unexpected situation with a bit of exaggeration.
grammarPages.pattern: 一 + Measure word (+ Noun) + 都／也 + 不／沒 + Verb

text.traditional: 我等了一個小時，一班公車都沒來。
text.simplified: 我等了一个小时，一班公车都没来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ děng le yí ge xiǎoshí, yì bān gōngchē dōu méi lái.
text.english: I waited for an hour, but not a single bus came.

text.traditional: 我忘了帶錢包，現在一毛（錢）都沒有。
text.simplified: 我忘了带钱包，现在一毛（钱）都没有。
text.pinyin: Wǒ wàngle dài qiánbāo, xiànzài yì máo (qián) dōu méiyǒu.
text.english: I forgot my wallet. Now I don't have even a dime.

text.traditional: 這裡一家醫院也沒有，要是生病了就很麻煩。
text.simplified: 这里一家医院也没有，要是生病了就很麻烦。
text.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yì jiā yīyuàn yě méiyǒu, yàoshì shēngbìng le jiù hěn máfán.
text.english: There isn't even one hospital here. If you get sick, it will be a lot of trouble.

text.traditional: 那個學生不愛上課，一個字都不願意寫，所以老師很生氣。
text.simplified: 那个学生不爱上课，一个字都不愿意写，所以老师很生气。
text.pinyin: Nà ge xuéshēng bú ài shàngkè, yí ge zì dōu bú yuànyì xiě, suǒyǐ lǎoshī hěn shēngqì.
text.english: That student doesn't like going to class and isn't willing to write even one character, so the teacher is very angry.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “一 M 都/也不（沒）” indicates “there is not any...” or “don't want any...”, and shows a strange and unexpected situation with a bit of exaggeration.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “一 M 都/也不（沒）” indicates “there is not any...” or “don't want any...”, and shows a strange and unexpected situation with a bit of exaggeration.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: 讓: to make, to let; to allow, to permit (politely)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Politely say that someone lets or allows another person to do something.
grammarPages.explanation: （1）This “讓” functions as a verb. There are different usages of 讓, such as “to make” and “to let”, ie: “有的 KTV 還有好玩的樂器，讓客人唱得更開心。（to make）（L6）” and the dialogue in this lesson, “讓美心請客吧。”（to let）. The “讓 (to let)” is more polite than “叫” or “要”, ie: “老師叫你去辦公室找他” is an order while “老師讓你去辦公室找他” is a polite expression. （2）“讓” also indicates to permit and to allow somebody to do something, ie: “父母讓我一個人在學校附近租房子。” and “我不舒服，老闆讓我回家休息。”

text.traditional: 他上班常遲到，工作也做不好，所以老闆讓/叫/要他明天別來上班了。
text.simplified: 他上班常迟到，工作也做不好，所以老板让/叫/要他明天别来上班了。
text.pinyin: Tā shàngbān cháng chídào, gōngzuò yě zuò bùhǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn ràng/ jiào/ yào tā míngtiān bié lái shàngbān le.
text.english: He is often late for work and doesn't do his work well, so the boss told him not to come to work tomorrow.

text.traditional: 陳小姐讓/叫/要男朋友在樓下等一下，因為她還沒選好要穿哪件衣服。
text.simplified: 陈小姐让/叫/要男朋友在楼下等一下，因为她还没选好要穿哪件衣服。
text.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě ràng/ jiào/ yào nánpéngyǒu zài lóuxià děng yíxià, yīnwèi tā háiméi xuǎn hǎo yào chuān nǎ jiàn yīfu.
text.english: Miss Chen asked her boyfriend to wait downstairs because she still hasn't chosen what to wear.

text.traditional: A：今天我忘了帶錢，讓你請吃午餐，可以嗎？B：沒問題，你想吃什麼？我讓餐廳老闆送過來。
text.simplified: A：今天我忘了带钱，让你请吃午餐，可以吗？B：没问题，你想吃什么？我让餐厅老板送过来。
text.pinyin: A: Jīntiān wǒ wàngle dài qián, ràng nǐ qǐng chī wǔcān, kěyǐ ma? B: Méi wèntí, nǐ xiǎng chī shénme? Wǒ ràng cāntīng lǎobǎn sòng guòlái.
text.english: A: I forgot to bring money today. Is it okay if I let you treat me to lunch? B: No problem. What do you want to eat? I'll have the restaurant owner deliver it.

text.traditional: 客人：這些菜吃不完，可不可以讓我帶回家？老闆：不可以喔！帶回去就不新鮮了。
text.simplified: 客人：这些菜吃不完，可不可以让我带回家？老板：不可以喔！带回去就不新鲜了。
text.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhèxiē cài chī bù wán, kě bù kěyǐ ràng wǒ dài huí jiā? Lǎobǎn: Bù kěyǐ o! Dài huí qù jiù bù xīnxiān le.
text.english: Guest: We can't finish these dishes. Can you let me take them home? Owner: No. They won't be fresh if you take them home.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: （1）This “讓” functions as a verb. There are different usages of 讓, such as “to make” and “to let”, ie: “有的 KTV 還有好玩的樂器，讓客人唱得更開心。（to make）（L6）” and the dialogue in this lesson, “讓美心請客吧。”（to let）. The “讓 (to let)” is more polite than “叫” or “要”, ie: “老師叫你去辦公室找他” is an order while “老師讓你去辦公室找他” is a polite expression. （2）“讓” also indicates to permit and to allow somebody to do something, ie: “父母讓我一個人在學校附近租房子。” and “我不舒服，老闆讓我回家休息。”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: （1）This “讓” functions as a verb. There are different usages of 讓, such as “to make” and “to let”, ie: “有的 KTV 還有好玩的樂器，讓客人唱得更開心。（to make）（L6）” and the dialogue in this lesson, “讓美心請客吧。”（to let）. The “讓 (to let)” is more polite than “叫” or “要”, ie: “老師叫你去辦公室找他” is an order while “老師讓你去辦公室找他” is a polite expression. （2）“讓” also indicates to permit and to allow somebody to do something, ie: “父母讓我一個人在學校附近租房子。” and “我不舒服，老闆讓我回家休息。”

grammarPages.titleEnglish: 是 + Adjective: indeed, it is true
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize that something really is a certain way.
grammarPages.explanation: In Chinese, intransitive state verbs, such as “美”, “漂亮”, “年輕”, etc., do not have to come after “是”. However, “是” can be added when the speaker wants to confirm or emphasize the degree of Vs.

text.traditional: A：我覺得王小姐比以前漂亮了。B：她是比以前漂亮多了。
text.simplified: A：我觉得王小姐比以前漂亮了。B：她是比以前漂亮多了。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ juéde Wáng xiǎojiě bǐ yǐqián piàoliàng le. B: Tā shì bǐ yǐqián piàoliàng duō le.
text.english: A: I think Miss Wang is prettier than before. B: She is indeed much prettier than before.

text.traditional: A：外國人都覺得中國字很難寫，你覺得呢？B：是有點兒難寫，可是多練習幾次就好了。
text.simplified: A：外国人都觉得中国字很难写，你觉得呢？B：是有点儿难写，可是多练习几次就好了。
text.pinyin: A: Wàiguórén dōu juéde Zhōngguó zì hěn nán xiě, nǐ juéde ne? B: Shì yǒudiǎnr nán xiě, kěshì duō liànxí jǐ cì jiù hǎo le.
text.english: A: Foreigners all think Chinese characters are hard to write. What do you think? B: They are indeed a little hard to write, but they'll be fine after a few more times of practice.

text.traditional: 良介：聽說蘇花公路的風景很美，是真的嗎？美心：是真的，可是下大雨的時候，那條路比較危險。
text.simplified: 良介：听说苏花公路的风景很美，是真的吗？美心：是真的，可是下大雨的时候，那条路比较危险。
text.pinyin: Liángjiè: Tīngshuō Sūhuā Gōnglù de fēngjǐng hěn měi, shì zhēnde ma? Měixīn: Shì zhēnde, kěshì xià dàyǔ de shíhòu, nà tiáo lù bǐjiào wéixiǎn.
text.english: Ryosuke: I heard the scenery on the Suhua Highway is beautiful. Is that true? Meixin: It is true, but that road is rather dangerous when it rains heavily.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In Chinese, intransitive state verbs, such as “美”, “漂亮”, “年輕”, etc., do not have to come after “是”. However, “是” can be added when the speaker wants to confirm or emphasize the degree of Vs.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In Chinese, intransitive state verbs, such as “美”, “漂亮”, “年輕”, etc., do not have to come after “是”. However, “是” can be added when the speaker wants to confirm or emphasize the degree of Vs.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something has been completely used up or eaten.
grammarPages.explanation: The “光” here serves as a verb complement denoting “running out” or “nothing left”, and sometimes it suggests a sense of regret and disappointment. It often collocates with “把”, ie: “把錢用光了” and “弟弟把糖吃光了”; however, “我把功課寫光了” is unacceptable.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (把 + Object) + Verb + 光 + 了

text.traditional: 弟弟把我的巧克力都吃光了，讓我很生氣。
text.simplified: 弟弟把我的巧克力都吃光了，让我很生气。
text.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ wǒ de qiǎokèlì dōu chī guāng le, ràng wǒ hěn shēngqì.
text.english: My younger brother ate all my chocolate, which made me very angry.

text.traditional: 時間很晚了，咖啡館的客人差不多都走光了。
text.simplified: 时间很晚了，咖啡馆的客人差不多都走光了。
text.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn wǎn le, kāfēiguǎn de kèrén chàbùduō dōu zǒu guāng le.
text.english: It was very late, and almost all the customers in the café had left.

text.traditional: 要是你一下子就把獎學金用光，下個月就沒錢付房租了。
text.simplified: 要是你一下子就把奖学金用光，下个月就没钱付房租了。
text.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐ yíxiàzi jiù bǎ jiǎngxuéjīn yòng guāng, xià ge yuè jiù méi qián fù fángzū le.
text.english: If you use up your scholarship all at once, you won't have money to pay rent next month.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The “光” here serves as a verb complement denoting “running out” or “nothing left”, and sometimes it suggests a sense of regret and disappointment. It often collocates with “把”, ie: “把錢用光了” and “弟弟把糖吃光了”; however, “我把功課寫光了” is unacceptable.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The “光” here serves as a verb complement denoting “running out” or “nothing left”, and sometimes it suggests a sense of regret and disappointment. It often collocates with “把”, ie: “把錢用光了” and “弟弟把糖吃光了”; however, “我把功課寫光了” is unacceptable.

grammarPages.titleTraditional: 一點兒 + 都／也 + Neg + Vs
grammarPages.titleSimplified: 一点儿 + 都／也 + Neg + Vs
grammarPages.titleEnglish: 一點兒都/也不: not at all
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say strongly that something is not at all a certain way.
grammarPages.explanation: The expression “一點兒都/也不” shows strong negation, often followed by verbs or state verbs to emphasize the subject is not in a certain status at all.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一點兒 + 都／也 + 不／沒 + Adjective／Verb

text.traditional: 這杯珍珠奶茶是無糖的，一點兒都不甜。
text.simplified: 这杯珍珠奶茶是无糖的，一点儿都不甜。
text.pinyin: Zhè bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá shì wú táng de, yìdiǎnr dōu bù tián.
text.english: This cup of bubble tea is sugar-free; it's not sweet at all.

text.traditional: 網路訂票一點兒也不難，你可以自己上網試試看。
text.simplified: 网路订票一点儿也不难，你可以自己上网试试看。
text.pinyin: Wǎnglù dìngpiào yìdiǎnr yě bù nán, nǐ kěyǐ zìjǐ shàngwǎng shìshi kàn.
text.english: Booking tickets online is not difficult at all. You can go online and try it yourself.

text.traditional: 我跟他一點兒都不熟，為什麼要一起去KTV唱歌呢？
text.simplified: 我跟他一点儿都不熟，为什么要一起去KTV唱歌呢？
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā yìdiǎnr dōu bù shóu, wèishénme yào yìqǐ qù KTV chànggē ne?
text.english: He and I are not close at all. Why would we go to KTV and sing together?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The expression “一點兒都/也不” shows strong negation, often followed by verbs or state verbs to emphasize the subject is not in a certain status at all.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The expression “一點兒都/也不” shows strong negation, often followed by verbs or state verbs to emphasize the subject is not in a certain status at all.

text.traditional: 我跟室友計畫春假去阿里山森林遊樂區走走。那時候草綠了、花開了，天氣也暖和了。不必帶太多行李，也不需要穿大衣，只要穿一雙好走的鞋子，再帶一件外套、雨衣、幾雙襪子跟幾件內衣褲就夠了。
text.simplified: 我跟室友计划春假去阿里山森林游乐区走走。那时候草绿了、花开了，天气也暖和了。不必带太多行李，也不需要穿大衣，只要穿一双好走的鞋子，再带一件外套、雨衣、几双袜子跟几件内衣裤就够了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu jìhuà chūnjià qù Ālǐ Shān sēnlín yóulè qū zǒuzǒu. Nà shíhòu cǎo lǜ le, huā kāi le, tiānqì yě nuǎnhuo le. Búbì dài tài duō xínglǐ, yě bù xūyào chuān dàyī, zhǐyào chuān yì shuāng hǎo zǒu de xiézi, zài dài yí jiàn wàitào, yǔyī, jǐ shuāng wàzi gēn jǐ jiàn nèiyīkù jiù gòu le.
text.english: My roommate and I are planning to walk around Alishan Forest Recreation Area during the spring break. At that time the grass is green, the flowers are blooming, and the weather is already warm, too. We do not have to bring too much luggage or wear a coat. Just wear a pair of good walking shoes, and then bring a jacket, a raincoat, a few pairs of socks and some underwear is enough.

text.traditional: 本來我想參加阿里山的團體旅遊，這樣就不必自己上網訂票、訂旅館，可是室友覺得自己去比較自由，也不趕時間，所以我們決定第一天搭台鐵到嘉義，再從嘉義搭小火車上阿里山，當天晚上就可以在山上散步、看星星了。沒想到剛上台鐵的網站，就發現春假第一天的票都賣光了。原來除了去國外旅行，想留在國內玩的人也不少。
text.simplified: 本来我想参加阿里山的团体旅游，这样就不必自己上网订票、订旅馆，可是室友觉得自己去比较自由，也不赶时间，所以我们决定第一天搭台铁到嘉义，再从嘉义搭小火车上阿里山，当天晚上就可以在山上散步、看星星了。没想到刚上台铁的网站，就发现春假第一天的票都卖光了。原来除了去国外旅行，想留在国内玩的人也不少。
text.pinyin: Běnlái wǒ xiǎng cānjiā Ālǐ Shān de tuántǐ lǚyóu, zhèyàng jiù búbì zìjǐ shàngwǎng dìngpiào, dìng lǚguǎn, kěshì shìyǒu juéde zìjǐ qù bǐjiào zìyóu, yě bù gǎn shíjiān, suǒyǐ wǒmen juédìng dìyī tiān dā Táitiě dào Jiāyì, zài cóng Jiāyì dā xiǎo huǒchē shàng Ālǐ Shān, dāngtiān wǎnshàng jiù kěyǐ zài shān shàng sànbù, kàn xīngxīng le. Méixiǎngdào gāng shàng Táitiě de wǎngzhàn, jiù fāxiàn chūnjià dìyī tiān de piào dōu mài guāng le. Yuánlái chúle qù guówài lǚxíng, xiǎng liú zài guónèi wán de rén yě bùshǎo.
text.english: Originally, I wanted to participate in a group tour to Alishan so that I wouldn't have to book the tickets or a hotel by myself. However, my roommate thought that going on our own gives us more freedom and we do not have to hurry. So we decided to take the Taiwan Railways to Chiayi on the first day, then take the Alishan Forest Railway to go up to Alishan, and we can take a walk and see the stars on the mountain that evening. I didn't expect as soon as I went to the website of Taiwan Railways to book the tickets for the first day of spring break, only to find that they had been sold out. It turns out that in addition to traveling abroad, many people still want to stay in the country and have fun.

text.traditional: 後來我上高鐵的網站，很幸運訂到了兩張台北到嘉義的車票，馬上用信用卡付了錢，這樣就放心了。雖然高鐵票比較貴，可是又快又舒服，而且第一天晚上住在嘉義市也不錯，因為當地的雞肉飯很有名，剛好趁這個機會去吃吃看。我正在想像一邊吃雞肉飯，一邊喝啤酒的樣子，室友忽然大叫，「成功了！阿里山小火車的票訂到了！」
text.simplified: 后来我上高铁的网站，很幸运订到了两张台北到嘉义的车票，马上用信用卡付了钱，这样就放心了。虽然高铁票比较贵，可是又快又舒服，而且第一天晚上住在嘉义市也不错，因为当地的鸡肉饭很有名，刚好趁这个机会去吃吃看。我正在想像一边吃鸡肉饭，一边喝啤酒的样子，室友忽然大叫，「成功了！阿里山小火车的票订到了！」
text.pinyin: Hòulái wǒ shàng gāotiě de wǎngzhàn, hěn xìngyùn dìng dào le liǎng zhāng Táiběi dào Jiāyì de chēpiào, mǎshàng yòng xìnyòngkǎ fù le qián, zhèyàng jiù fàngxīn le. Suīrán gāotiě piào bǐjiào guì, kěshì yòu kuài yòu shūfu, érqiě dìyī tiān wǎnshàng zhù zài Jiāyì Shì yě búcuò, yīnwèi dāngdì de jīròu fàn hěn yǒumíng, gānghǎo chèn zhège jīhuì qù chīchi kàn. Wǒ zhèngzài xiǎngxiàng yìbiān chī jīròu fàn, yìbiān hē píjiǔ de yàngzi, shìyǒu hūrán dà jiào, “Chénggōng le! Ālǐ Shān xiǎo huǒchē de piào dìng dào le!”
text.english: Later, on the website of the High Speed Rail, I was lucky enough to book two tickets from Taipei to Chiayi. I immediately paid for them with a credit card, so I was relieved. Although the high-speed rail tickets are more expensive, the HSR is fast and comfortable. It is also good to stay in Chiayi City the first night because the local chicken rice is well-known and I can take this opportunity to try it. When I was imagining that we were drinking beer while eating chicken rice, my roommate suddenly shouted “I made it! I booked the Alishan Forest Railway tickets!”

text.traditional: 我們能利用網路做好多事情，除了訂車票、機票、餐廳，還能買到各式各樣、又便宜又流行的衣服。有網路真好！
text.simplified: 我们能利用网路做好多事情，除了订车票、机票、餐厅，还能买到各式各样、又便宜又流行的衣服。有网路真好！
text.pinyin: Wǒmen néng lìyòng wǎnglù zuò hǎo duō shìqíng, chúle dìng chēpiào, jīpiào, cāntīng, hái néng mǎi dào gèshìgèyàng, yòu piányí yòu liúxíng de yīfu. Yǒu wǎnglù zhēn hǎo!
text.english: We can use the Internet to do so many things. In addition to booking public transport tickets, air tickets, restaurants, we can also buy a variety of inexpensive fashion clothes. It's really great to have the Internet!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that one thing happened right after another.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern indicates when the situation after “剛” happens, another situation or action occurs right away. It emphasizes the close connection between two situations or actions. If the two clauses has different subjects, the subject of the latter clause should be placed before “就”.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 剛 + Verb₁，(+ Subject₂) + 就 + Verb₂

text.traditional: 那個蛋糕剛烤好就被孩子吃光了。
text.simplified: 那个蛋糕刚烤好就被孩子吃光了。
text.pinyin: Nà ge dàngāo gāng kǎo hǎo jiù bèi háizi chī guāng le.
text.english: That cake was eaten up by the children as soon as it was baked.

text.traditional: 他剛搬進宿舍，無線網路就壞了。
text.simplified: 他刚搬进宿舍，无线网路就坏了。
text.pinyin: Tā gāng bān jìn sùshè, wúxiàn wǎnglù jiù huài le.
text.english: The Wi-Fi broke right after he moved into the dorm.

text.traditional: 他剛畢業就找到了一份好工作，真是太幸運了！
text.simplified: 他刚毕业就找到了一份好工作，真是太幸运了！
text.pinyin: Tā gāng bìyè jiù zhǎodào le yí fèn hǎo gōngzuò, zhēnshì tài xìngyùn le!
text.english: He found a good job right after graduating. He is really so lucky!

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern indicates when the situation after “剛” happens, another situation or action occurs right away. It emphasizes the close connection between two situations or actions. If the two clauses has different subjects, the subject of the latter clause should be placed before “就”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates when the situation after “剛” happens, another situation or action occurs right away. It emphasizes the close connection between two situations or actions. If the two clauses has different subjects, the subject of the latter clause should be placed before “就”.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone uses a good chance or time to do something.
grammarPages.explanation: The expression “趁著” means taking advantage of a certain chance or time to do something beneficial to oneself. “趁” can be followed by nouns, verb phrases, and intransitive state verbs, etc.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 趁（著）+ Chance／Time + Verb Phrase

text.traditional: 媽媽趁（著）好天氣，把髒衣服都洗了。
text.simplified: 妈妈趁（着）好天气，把脏衣服都洗了。
text.pinyin: Māma chèn (zhe) hǎo tiānqì, bǎ zāng yīfu dōu xǐ le.
text.english: Mom took advantage of the good weather and washed all the dirty clothes.

text.traditional: 張先生趁著到花蓮旅行時，買了一些當地的名產。
text.simplified: 张先生趁着到花莲旅行时，买了一些当地的名产。
text.pinyin: Zhāng xiānshēng chènzhe dào Huālián lǚxíng shí, mǎi le yìxiē dāngdì de míngchǎn.
text.english: Mr. Zhang took advantage of his trip to Hualien to buy some local specialties.

text.traditional: 他趁著去法國留學的時候，參觀了有名的博物館。
text.simplified: 他趁着去法国留学的时候，参观了有名的博物馆。
text.pinyin: Tā chènzhe qù Fǎguó liúxué de shíhòu, cānguān le yǒumíng de bówùguǎn.
text.english: He took advantage of his time studying in France to visit famous museums.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The expression “趁著” means taking advantage of a certain chance or time to do something beneficial to oneself. “趁” can be followed by nouns, verb phrases, and intransitive state verbs, etc.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The expression “趁著” means taking advantage of a certain chance or time to do something beneficial to oneself. “趁” can be followed by nouns, verb phrases, and intransitive state verbs, etc.
